subject: LuminexOps continuity questionnaire: RTO proofs & test artifacts
messages:
From: Sara Quinn <sara.quinn@auditco.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>; procurement@luminexops.com
Cc: security@luminexops.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LuminexOps SIG - follow-up: BCP evidence and RTO/RPO artifacts

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking the SIG intake call yesterday. LuminexOps has a few follow-ups before their executive review next Wednesday: specifically, they asked for concrete evidence that Redwood meets the stated RTO and RPO in the customer-facing SLA. Can you provide the following items by COB Friday?

- System-level RTO/RPO attestation (signed by an engineering lead)
- Latest scheduled DR test report including scope and recovery times (ideally the redacted test script + outcomes)
- Backup retention summary and proof of restore verification for last quarter
- Runbook excerpt showing failover steps for the inference control plane

If any of those are on a shared drive, a link is fine; for anything sensitive we can accept a redacted PDF. LuminexOps is particularly concerned about cross-region failover timing and cache rehydration behavior, so any measured metrics there would be helpful.

Appreciate your help — we want to make sure we close the SIG submission cleanly.

Best,
Sara
Sara Quinn
Senior Security Assessor
AuditCo

Marcus will prepare the engineering attestation; Monica will add a short note on cross-region cache rehydration behavior and observed timings. Expect an attestation PDF + brief technical memo by Thursday EOD.

Let me know if LuminexOps needs additional raw logs or a Zoom walkthrough of the DR test results.

Thanks,

Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LuminexOps SIG - follow-up: BCP evidence and RTO/RPO artifacts

Hi all — attaching the signed engineering attestation (engineer-attestation-2026-09-02.pdf) as requested. Key excerpts below for fast review: 

- Claimed production RTO for inference control-plane: 15 minutes for regional failover under configured Dedicated topology.
- Measured live failover (2026-08-24): median recovery observed 12m 40s; 95th percentile 18m 10s. Test scope: simulated regional AZ outage with automated routing + Cache rehydration disabled (cold-start).
- RPO: backups + continuous WAL-style snapshots limit RPO to 1 minute for critical metadata and 5 minutes for bulk model artifacts (with our streaming checkpoint).

Monica: attaching a 1-page note on cache rehydration and warm-up patterns (cache-note-2026-08-24.txt). Karthik is copied for the attestation signature coordination.

- Marcus

Attachments:
- engineer-attestation-2026-09-02.pdf (PDF, signed)
- cache-note-2026-08-24.txt (text)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Sara Quinn <sara.quinn@auditco.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LuminexOps SIG - follow-up: BCP evidence and RTO/RPO artifacts

Adding the operational context Sara flagged on cache rehydration and cross-region failover. Summary points for LuminexOps: 

- During the 2026-08-24 live failover we observed an initial 30–45s spike while routing converged; model KV cache rehydration (cold start) to 80% hit-rate took ~9 minutes in the Dedicated topology used for the test.
- For customers sensitive to cold-cache latency we recommend: pre-warmed standby pools + periodic KV snapshot push (documented in runbook). This reduces effective end-user observed RTO to ~4–6 minutes in our tests.
- Backup restores: full config + metadata restore verified in a dev replay environment (restore runbook entry 4.3). Verified file hashes included in the CSV.

If Sara or LuminexOps would like, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough of the spreadsheet and the runbook excerpt Friday.

—Monica
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Quinn <sara.quinn@auditco.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>; Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example.com>

Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LuminexOps SIG - follow-up: BCP evidence and RTO/RPO artifacts

Thanks — this is perfect and exactly what the review board needed. A couple of small asks:

- Please upload the signed engineering attestation to the shared Drive link (so the LuminexOps legal team sees it directly).
- Can you redact internal IPs from the backup CSV and re-upload a sanitized copy?

Otherwise we'll mark the SIG item as resolved and circle back if we need deeper logs. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the cache mitigation guidance — LuminexOps would like the optional 30-minute walkthrough next Friday at 10am PT if that works for your team.

Best,
Sara
